generalfeedback.text:
[[lang code="ja"]]

\(\def\Wa{\boldsymbol a}D(A)=D(...,a_{ij},...) = D(\Wa_1, \Wa_2, \dots, \Wa_n)\)が 多重線形性と退化性を満たすと仮定すると,

\(\def\We{\boldsymbol e}a_{\sigma_11}a_{\sigma_22}\cdots a_{\sigma_nn}D(\We_{\sigma_1},\We_{\sigma_2},\dots,\We_{\sigma_n})\)の形の項の和になるのでした.

ここで, \(\sigma=[\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\dots,\sigma_n]\)は\([1,2,\dots,n]\)の順列すべてを動くということでした.

ここで, 交代性を用いると, \(D(\We_{\sigma_1},\We_{\sigma_2},\dots,\We_{\sigma_n})\)は\(\sigma\)の反転数\(N_\sigma\)を用いて, \((-1)^{N_\sigma}=\pm 1\)となるので, これを\(a_{\sigma_11}a_{\sigma_22}\cdots a_{\sigma_nn}\)の符号数と呼ぶことにします.

ここでは, この符号数を計算してもらっているわけです.

[[/lang]] [[lang code="en"]]

Suppose that \(\def\Wa{\boldsymbol a} D(A)=D(\ldots,a_{ij},\ldots)=D(\Wa_1,\Wa_2,\dots,\Wa_n)\) satisfies multilinearity and degeneracy.

Then the determinant can be expressed as a sum of terms of the form \(\def\We{\boldsymbol e} a_{\sigma_11}a_{\sigma_22}\cdots a_{\sigma_nn} D(\We_{\sigma_1},\We_{\sigma_2},\dots,\We_{\sigma_n})\).

Here, \(\sigma=[\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\dots,\sigma_n]\) runs through all permutations of \([1,2,\dots,n]\).

Using the alternating property, \(D(\We_{\sigma_1},\We_{\sigma_2},\dots,\We_{\sigma_n})=(-1)^{N_\sigma}=\pm1\), where \(N_\sigma\) denotes the inversion number of the permutation \(\sigma\). We call this value the sign of \(a_{\sigma_11}a_{\sigma_22}\cdots a_{\sigma_nn}\).

In this exercise, you are asked to compute this sign.

[[/lang]] [[lang code="fr"]]

Supposons que \(\def\Wa{\boldsymbol a} D(A)=D(\ldots,a_{ij},\ldots)=D(\Wa_1,\Wa_2,\dots,\Wa_n)\) satisfasse la multilinéarité et la dégénérescence.

Alors, le déterminant peut être exprimé comme une somme de termes de la forme \(\def\We{\boldsymbol e} a_{\sigma_11}a_{\sigma_22}\cdots a_{\sigma_nn} D(\We_{\sigma_1},\We_{\sigma_2},\dots,\We_{\sigma_n})\).

Ici, \(\sigma=[\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\dots,\sigma_n]\) parcourt toutes les permutations de \([1,2,\dots,n]\).

En utilisant la propriété alternée, \(D(\We_{\sigma_1},\We_{\sigma_2},\dots,\We_{\sigma_n})=(-1)^{N_\sigma}=\pm1\), où \(N_\sigma\) désigne le nombre d’inversions de la permutation \(\sigma\). Nous appelons cette valeur le signe de \(a_{\sigma_11}a_{\sigma_22}\cdots a_{\sigma_nn}\).

Dans cet exercice, il vous est demandé de calculer ce signe.

[[/lang]] [[lang code="de"]]

Angenommen, \(\def\Wa{\boldsymbol a} D(A)=D(\ldots,a_{ij},\ldots)=D(\Wa_1,\Wa_2,\dots,\Wa_n)\) erfüllt die Multilinearität und die Degeneriertheit.

Dann lässt sich die Determinante als Summe von Termen der Form \(\def\We{\boldsymbol e} a_{\sigma_11}a_{\sigma_22}\cdots a_{\sigma_nn} D(\We_{\sigma_1},\We_{\sigma_2},\dots,\We_{\sigma_n})\) darstellen.

Dabei durchläuft \(\sigma=[\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\dots,\sigma_n]\) alle Permutationen von \([1,2,\dots,n]\).

Unter Verwendung der alternierenden Eigenschaft gilt \(D(\We_{\sigma_1},\We_{\sigma_2},\dots,\We_{\sigma_n})=(-1)^{N_\sigma}=\pm1\), wobei \(N_\sigma\) die Inversionszahl der Permutation \(\sigma\) bezeichnet. Diesen Wert nennen wir das Vorzeichen von \(a_{\sigma_11}a_{\sigma_22}\cdots a_{\sigma_nn}\).

In dieser Aufgabe sollen Sie dieses Vorzeichen bestimmen.

[[/lang]] [[lang code="it"]]

Supponiamo che \(\def\Wa{\boldsymbol a} D(A)=D(\ldots,a_{ij},\ldots)=D(\Wa_1,\Wa_2,\dots,\Wa_n)\) soddisfi la multilinearità e la degenerazione.

Allora il determinante può essere espresso come una somma di termini della forma \(\def\We{\boldsymbol e} a_{\sigma_11}a_{\sigma_22}\cdots a_{\sigma_nn} D(\We_{\sigma_1},\We_{\sigma_2},\dots,\We_{\sigma_n})\).

Qui, \(\sigma=[\sigma_1,\sigma_2,\dots,\sigma_n]\) varia su tutte le permutazioni di \([1,2,\dots,n]\).

Utilizzando la proprietà alternante, \(D(\We_{\sigma_1},\We_{\sigma_2},\dots,\We_{\sigma_n})=(-1)^{N_\sigma}=\pm1\), dove \(N_\sigma\) indica il numero di inversioni della permutazione \(\sigma\). Chiamiamo questo valore il segno di \(a_{\sigma_11}a_{\sigma_22}\cdots a_{\sigma_nn}\).

In questo esercizio, ti viene chiesto di calcolare questo segno.

[[/lang]]

prtcorrect.text: よくできました。正解です!
